segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We're very grateful that the Committee has agreed that a representative for the Students' Union can present students' suggestions about the design for the proposed new Union building.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We appreciate that some of our ideas may not be feasible in the circumstances, but we do feel that it is important that the ultimate beneficiaries of the facilities should have some say in its design.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: If I could start by briefly explaining what steps were taken to find out student opinion and how we have arrived at conclusions.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Firstly. a meeting was held in the current Union for our SU Committee to explain the options.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Then we invited all students to submit written suggestions for the design, placing cards in a suggestion box.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: These suggestions then provided the basis for the design of a questionnaire. which was completed by approximately , two thousand of the College students over a period of three weeks.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Finally, the SU Committee collated the results and drew up a report.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: If I can just hand around a copy of that report.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This presentation is essentially a summary and discussion of the key points of this report.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: So, in broad terms, the consensus was as follows.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Firstly. regarding the crucial matter of the site, we presented the three options that you have proposed.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: One: in the city centre, near

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: two: on the outskirts of the city, near the park, and three: out of town, near the halls of residence.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: We asked students to cite reasons for and against these sites and, and there was remarkable agreement on all three.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: Site One was unpopular because of traffic and parking problems.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: Site Two had a number of supporters, mainly because it was close to most lecture rooms.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: And Site Three, out of town, near the halls of residence. was clearly the most popular because of access from living quarters.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: It was clear that the Union was mainly to be used after lectures.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: It was also felt that the larger site would allow more room for a choice of facilities.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: Our second area of interest was obviously the facilities: there was minimal interest in having a library on the premises, but one option seemed to be a reading room instead - more useful.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: We would like the current table games room to be replaced with a small gym.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: And, if possible, a small swimming pool - not. of course, Olympic-sized!

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: There was a large number of respondents in favour of a travel agent's and insurance centre.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: We also request that there be the offices of the Student Counselling Centre, moving this from the Refectory.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: There was, however, much disagreement about whether to build a drama theatre.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: Just over forty per cent of the respondents were in favour, but a largish minority were strongly against it, claiming that it is elitist and a waste of funds.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: Essentially the jury is out on that.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: Fina!Jy, given the number of unfortunate incidents in the current Union over the past few months, a strong point was repeatedly made about security.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: The recommendations would be at least video surveillance and security personnel who wouid check Student Union cards on ~· We doubt if it would be feasible to have a check at reception of all people coming in.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: Well, this is the summary of the views of the student population.

segments.speaker: THE FACULTY OF EDUCATION
segments.en: As I say. fuller details are given in our report but I'm happy to take any questions if you have them . . . (fade out)
